report_name: TSMC Confirms Employee Data Breach via Third-Party Cloud Vendor

threat_actors.name: TSMC Cloud Vendor Breach Actor
threat_actors.description: An unnamed threat actor who compromised a third-party cloud vendor of TSMC to steal employee data and offer it for sale on a cybercrime forum for 3 BTC.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The data breach was a supply chain attack, where the threat actor gained access to TSMC employee data by compromising a third-party cloud service provider.

attack_patterns.name: Acquire Access
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor first compromised the third-party cloud service provider to gain access to its environment.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Once inside the vendor's environment, the attacker located and exfiltrated the TSMC employee database from the compromised cloud storage.

identities.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC)
identities.description: The world's largest chipmaker, whose employee data was exposed through a breach at a third-party cloud vendor. The breach exposed PII for 46,000 current and former employees.
